tagline: 柯达旁轴相机，1938 年发布
description: 柯达于1938年推出的旁轴相机。配备Kodak Anastigmat Special 100mm f/3.5, focus 4ft-infinity。快门速度Compur, 8 speeds up to 1/200; shutter priority auto from 1/25-1/200, slower speeds available manually。使用620, frame size 2¼ x 3¼ inches, 6x9cm。

specs.快门: Compur, 8 speeds up to 1/200; shutter priority auto from 1/25-1/200, slower speeds available manually
specs.英文简介: The Super Kodak Six-20 is accepted as being the world's first camera with automatic exposure, despite its small production run.
